articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 06 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_06_Integrated_Projects/Chapter_06_Integrated_Projects_KR.md Volume…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 06 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_06_Integrated_Projects/Chapter_06_Integrated_Projects_KR.md Volume 02. Knowledge Representation 06. Integrated Projects 06.01 Logic Inference Engine [w/Code] 논리 추론 엔진(Logic Inference Engine)은 명시적으로 표현된 사실(Fact)과 논리 규칙(Logical Rule)으로부터 새로운 지식을 도출하는 계산 시스템(Computational System)이다. 논리 추론 엔진은 형식적 추론 원리(Formal Reasoning Principle)를 실행 가능한 연산(Executable Operation)으로 변환하여 기호적 인공지능(Symbolic Artificial Intelligence)을 위한 실용적인 기반을 제공한다. 통합 구현(Integrated Implementation)은 지식 표현(Knowledge Representation), 규칙 평가(Rule Evaluation), 질의 처리(Query Processing), 설명 생성(Explanation Generation)을 일관된 아키텍처(Architecture)로 연결한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Knowledge Representation — Ch.05: Neuro Symbolic AI [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 05 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_05_Neuro_Symbolic_AI/Chapter_05_Neuro_Symbolic_AI_KR.md Volume 02.…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 05 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_05_Neuro_Symbolic_AI/Chapter_05_Neuro_Symbolic_AI_KR.md Volume 02. Knowledge Representation 05. Neuro Symbolic AI 05.01 Introduction to Neuro Symbolic 신경-상징적 인공지능(Neuro-symbolic artificial intelligence)은 신경망 학습(neural learning)과 상징적 지식 표현 및 추론(symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning)을 통합하는 접근 방식입니다. 이는 복잡한 데이터에서 패턴을 인식하는 신경망의 능력과 개념, 관계, 제약 조건 및 논리적 규칙을 표현하는 상징적 시스템의 능력을 결합합니다. 목표는 구조화되고 해석 가능한 추론을 수행하면서 경험으로부터 배울 수 있는 지능형 시스템을 개발하는 것입니다. 전통적인 인공지능은 두 가지 주요 연구 방향을 따라 발전했습니다. 상징적 AI(Symbolic AI)는 명시적 지식, 형식 논리, 규칙 기반 추론을 강조한 반면, 연결주의 AI(connectionist AI)는 데이터로부터 분산 표현(distributed representations)을 학습하는 데 집중했습니다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Knowledge Representation — Ch.04: Rule Based Systems [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 04 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_04_Rule_Based_Systems/Chapter_04_Rule_Based_Systems_KR.md Volume 0…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 04 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_04_Rule_Based_Systems/Chapter_04_Rule_Based_Systems_KR.md Volume 02. Knowledge Representation 04. Rule Based Systems 04.01 Introduction to Rule Systems 규칙 기반 시스템(Rule-based systems)은 인공지능의 근본적인 접근 방식 중 하나로, 명시적으로 정의된 지식과 논리적 조건을 통해 컴퓨터가 의사결정을 내릴 수 있도록 합니다. 이러한 시스템은 순전히 통계적 패턴으로부터 동작을 학습하는 대신, 사용 가능한 사실(facts)에 미리 정의된 규칙을 적용합니다. 주요 목적은 인간의 전문 지식, 조직의 정책 및 도메인 지식을 일관되고 실행 가능한 추론 절차로 변환하는 것입니다. 규칙 기반 시스템의 핵심 원칙은 지식과 이를 처리하는 메커니즘을 분리하는 것입니다. 지식은 조건과 결론 사이의 관계를 설명하는 규칙을 통해 표현되며, 추론 엔진(inference engine)은 특정 상황에 어떤 규칙이 적용되는지 결정합니다. 이러한 분리를 통해 개발자와 도메인 전문가는 전체 계산 시스템을 재설계하지 않고도 의사결정 논리를 수정할 수 있습니다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: When a Martian Canyon Refuses to Stay Still, Why Should Your Vision?
articles.excerpt: When a Martian Canyon Refuses to Stay Still, Why Should Your Vision? The news broke this week: Valles Marineris, the 4,000‑kilometer scar that splits Mars, is still tectonically active. Not frozen, no…
articles.body: When a Martian Canyon Refuses to Stay Still, Why Should Your Vision? The news broke this week: Valles Marineris, the 4,000‑kilometer scar that splits Mars, is still tectonically active. Not frozen, not finished — still shifting. The paper from Columbia’s Lamont‑Doherty Earth Observatory hit the top of Hacker News, and the comment thread quickly turned from planetary geology to a familiar debate in vision science: the “critical period” dogma that says amblyopia (lazy eye) can only be treated before age 7‑10. I’ve lived that dogma. I was diagnosed with moderate amblyopia in my right eye at six, patched for years, and told the window had closed. By the time I was a teenager I’d accepted a flat, two‑dimensional world.
articles.author: Ashish

articles.title: Knowledge Representation — Ch.03: Knowledge Graph [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 03 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_03_Knowledge_Graph/Chapter_03_Knowledge_Graph_KR.md Volume 02. Kno…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 03 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_03_Knowledge_Graph/Chapter_03_Knowledge_Graph_KR.md Volume 02. Knowledge Representation 03. Knowledge Graph 03.01 Introduction to Knowledge Graphs 지식 그래프(Knowledge Graph)는 엔티티(개체), 엔티티의 속성, 그리고 이들 간의 관계가 명시적으로 연결된 정보의 구조화된 표현 방식입니다. 파편화된 기록이나 비구조화된 문서와 달리, 지식 그래프는 개념과 현실 세계의 객체가 서로 어떻게 관련되어 있는지를 포착합니다. 이러한 상호 연결된 표현 방식은 인공지능 시스템이 정보를 체계화하고, 관계를 탐색하며, 의미 있는 지식 기반 추론을 지원할 수 있도록 합니다. 지식 그래프의 근본적인 목적은 단편화된 정보를 의미 있는 사실들의 상호 연결된 네트워크로 변환하는 것입니다. 기업이나 조직은 수많은 데이터베이스, 문서, 애플리케이션 및 외부 서비스에 걸쳐 정보를 관리하는 경우가 많습니다. 지식 그래프는 이러한 출처들 사이에 명시적인 관계를 수립하여, 정보가 독립된 데이터 요소로 취급되는 대신 공유된 의미적 맥락(semantic context) 안에서 해석될 수 있도록 합니다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Knowledge Representation — Ch.02: Ontology [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 02 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_02_Ontology/Chapter_02_Ontology_KR.md Volume 02. Knowledge Represe…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 02 · Chapter 02 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_02_Knowledge_Representation/blob/main/Chapter_02_Ontology/Chapter_02_Ontology_KR.md Volume 02. Knowledge Representation 02. Ontology 02.01 What is Ontology 02.02 Knowledge Modeling Basics 지식 모델링(Knowledge Modeling)은 도메인(Domain)의 개념(Concept), 개별 개체(Individual Entity), 속성(Attribute), 관계(Relationship)를 컴퓨터 시스템이 해석할 수 있는 구조화된 표현(Structured Representation)으로 조직하는 과정이다. 온톨로지 공학(Ontology Engineering)에서 이 과정은 특정 도메인에 무엇이 존재하고 각 요소가 어떻게 상호작용하는지를 기술하는 개념적 기반(Conceptual Foundation)을 확립한다. 클래스(Class), 인스턴스(Instance), 속성(Property), 분류 계층(Taxonomic Hierarchy)은 일관되고 재사용 가능한 지식 모델(Knowledge Model)을 구성하는 핵심 요소이다. 지식 모델(Knowledge Model)은 정보의 의미와 조직 방식을 명시적으로 기술한다는 점에서 일반적인 레코드(Record) 집합과 구별된다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: GoAccess reports need their own access policy
articles.excerpt: GoAccess reports need their own access policy GoAccess parses web server logs and produces an interactive report. It can run in a terminal or generate an HTML dashboard with a WebSocket feed for live…
articles.body: GoAccess reports need their own access policy GoAccess parses web server logs and produces an interactive report. It can run in a terminal or generate an HTML dashboard with a WebSocket feed for live updates. The report is often placed under a web server's document root, which makes access control a deployment decision rather than a feature of the analyzer. The official documentation notes that a static report still needs a web server to be accessed and that the live HTML report uses GoAccess's own WebSocket server. It also documents authentication markers and options, including HTTP authentication fields and WebSocket JWT support in the manual. Those features matter because the report can reveal request paths, status codes, user agents, referrers, remote addresses, and traffic patterns.
articles.author: andreagomez

articles.body: Epic Games has revealed the drop rate for Fortnite 's Pirate Token after backlash surrounding the infamous in-game pickup saw fans try to report the studio to the FTC. It's been just one week since Epic turned the Item Shop on its head with the launch of its Treasure Hunters mini-season November 1. At the center of the backlash is the Pirate Token, an ultra-rare drop that grants access to the Pirate Shop and effectively makes just about every item in the shop free for 14 days. It's an in-game collectible with unprecedented value, so naturally, it's sent players into a frenzy as they turn over every chest in hopes of finding one for themselves.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 7, 1992: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor, its 1st Mars mission in 20 years at the time, to map the Red Planet like never before
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission, the first Mars mission in 20 years. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission. This was the first mission NASA sent to Mars in almost 20 years! The Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft was an orbiter. It transmitted data from NASA's Mars rovers Sojourner , Spirit and Opportunity back to Earth. The spacecraft also did a lot of its own science. It found surface channels on Mars that appeared to have been created by running water. Mars Global Surveyor looked at the south pole of Mars and saw signs of possible climate change. It also saw a mineral called hematite on Mars. Hematite usually forms in water. NASA then sent its Spirit and Opportunity rovers to look for the hematite, and both rovers found it near their landing sites. Mars Global Surveyor survived much longer than expected.

articles.title: Send your name to Saturn's moon Titan with NASA's upcoming Dragonfly mission
articles.excerpt: NASA is asking the public to send their names to Titan for an ambitious mission that will see a flying craft explore the Saturn moon in 2034, if all goes according to plan.
articles.body: We still may be some time away from sending humans to distant reaches of the solar system, but you can send your name to Saturn's moon Titan, which has the ingredients of life on its surface thanks to NASA's Dragonfly mission. Dragonfly is an SUV-sized nuclear-powered rotorcraft that NASA aims to launch towards Titan in 2028. The agency opened a special events page in late October to allow members of the public to put their name on the spacecraft. The names will be put upon a chip on Dragonfly during the spacecraft's assembly, and all names must be submitted before Jan. 15, 2027. The agency says that the mission has no "ordinary itinerary," as Dragonfly aims to between areas miles (or kilometers) apart after arriving on the surface in 2034.

articles.body: After a tumultuous start to EA's rebooted Star Wars Battlefront series, in 2021 Lucasfilm and Disney decided to open up the development of new Star Wars games by bringing in different publishers and studios under the Lucasfilm Games banner. Now, over five years on, we can confidently say we're entering a new golden era of amazing Star Wars games . With LucasArts' successor calling the shots and coordinating a multitude of projects set in a galaxy far, far away, even EA's latest efforts like Squadrons and the Jedi series have taken bigger and bolder swings.
